task_summary: Analyze SEC Form 13F-HR filings for Q2 and Q3 2025 to answer questions about hedge fund AUM, holdings, quarter-over-quarter changes, and top holders of specific stocks.
decomposition_rationale: The task is a focused 13F analysis pipeline where all questions rely on a shared set of data loading, entity resolution, and holdings analysis utilities. A single cohesive skill covering the 13F dataset toolkit minimizes overlap and matches the unified background research.

skills.name: evo-sec13f-analyzer
skills.description: Toolkit for parsing SEC Form 13F-HR quarterly TSV datasets: load COVERPAGE/INFOTABLE/SUMMARYPAGE with proper dtypes, fuzzy-match fund manager names with RapidFuzz, retrieve fund AUM, aggregate unique equity holdings (filtering options), compare holdings across quarters, and rank top holders of a given CUSIP. Use whenever working with the /root/2025-q2 and /root/2025-q3 13F TSV files.
skills.responsibility: Provide all data loading, entity resolution, and holdings analytics utilities for SEC 13F datasets.
dr_sections: The Critical 2023 SEC Value Reporting Rule Change
Data Processing and Loading with Pandas
Advanced Analytical Patterns in Hedge Fund Analysis
